registration.intro: S MAHI Global Services tana taimakawa wajen hada kwararrun ma'aikata da damarmaki na duniya ta hanyar amfani da fasaha mai inganci. Ma'aikatanmu suna da kwarewa sosai.
registration.p1_text: Manufarmu ita ce samar da ayyuka masu inganci ga abokan cinikinmu ta hanyar hada su da kwararrun ma'aikata da aka tantance.
registration.p2_text: Dole ne masu amfani su bayar da sahihan bayanai. Duk wani bayani na karya zai iya kaiwa ga toshe asusu.
registration.p3_text: Duk ma'aikacin da ya yi rajista dole ne ya mika takardun shaidar kwarewa kafin a amince da shi.
registration.p4_text: Smahi ba zata dauki alhakin duk wani rashin jituwa tsakanin ma'aikaci da abokin ciniki ba, amma zamu taimaka wajen sanya ido.
registration.p5_text: Muna kiyaye bayanan ku kuma ba zamu taba sayar da su ga wasu kamfanoni ba.
registration.p6_text: Kamfanin S. MAHI yana da hakkin canza wadannan ka'idoji a kowane lokaci.
registration.p7_text: Duk wani aiki da ya saba wa dokar kasa zai sa a dauki matakin shari'a.
registration.p8_text: Ana bada shawarar yin amfani da manhajar mu wajen biyan kuɗi don tabbatar da tsaro.
registration.agree: Na karanta kuma na yarda da waɗannan ka'idoji
